player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ye Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma kɔnɔ {num_rounds} turu la.

Jɛŋɛ Kɔnɔ:
- Kɛlɛ kɔ kɔnɔ, i ni {total_conversation_rounds} turu la ka kuma dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.
- O kɔ fɛ, n'ga player wɛrɛ wɛlɛ ka cooperate bee ka defect kɛlɛ kɔ.

Payoff Matrix (kɛlɛ kɔnɔ):
- Wɛrɛ wɛrɛ Cooperate ➜ kɛlɛ {cooperate_reward}
- Wɛrɛ wɛrɛ Defect ➜ kɛlɛ {mutual_defect_reward}
- Kɛlɛ kɔ Defects, kɛlɛ kɔ Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Jɛŋɛ Kɛlɛ:
- Kuma dɔɔnin dɔɔnin: i ni kuma dɔɔnin i ni baara.
- Kɛlɛ kɔ fɛ: '[Cooperate]' bee '[Defect]' kɔ (case-insensitive). I ni kuma dɔɔnin i ni baara pɛrɛ/pɛrɛn token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kabara donni kɛlɛnkɛla ye round {round}. An bɛ a yɛrɛ '[Cooperate]' wa '[Defect]' kɔnɔ \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: A ye bɔlɔlɔw bɛɛ ka bara kɛ {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Jagolaw fila bɛɛ ye dɛmɛ don ɲɔgɔn na.
outcome.round_both_defect: O fɔlikɛla fila bɛɛ y'u yɛrɛ di.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Jwé 0 ka kɛlɛ, Jwé 1 ka kɛlɛw kɔrɔ.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Jagokɛla 0 ye cɛsiri kɛ, jogucɛ 1 bɛ dɛmɛ don.
